learning_objective: 🎯 Become a geometry architect by using tools to draw perfect shapes and explore the beautiful world of repeating floor patterns!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: To build real-world structures, we need extreme precision. Using a ruler for straight edges and a compass for perfect curves and circles allows us to construct geometric masterpieces without guessing.

Did you know you can use a compass to perfectly cut an angle exactly in half? This is called bisecting! You can also use these tools to clone a line segment so it is exactly the same length as the original.
Tiling, or tessellation, is when shapes fit perfectly together on a flat surface without leaving any gaps or overlapping. Honeycombs made by bees are perfect natural examples of hexagonal tilings!

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Floor Designer
fun_activity.instructions: Take a piece of paper and try to cover it completely using only triangles and squares drawn with a ruler. Make sure there are zero gaps between the shapes to create a perfect tiling pattern!

quick_recap: ⭐ A compass and ruler are essential tools for precise geometric constructions.
⭐ Bisecting means dividing a line or angle into two perfectly equal parts.
⭐ Tiling requires specific shapes that interlock completely without any spaces.
